title_zh: 核对虚构咖啡馆预测的顾客假设

scenario.label_zh: 核对虚构咖啡馆预测与潜在顾客兴趣的区别
scenario.goal_zh: 识别盈利预测依赖的订单假设并约定把潜在兴趣与实际购买分开

context_zh: 商业英语课堂使用虚构咖啡馆计划，学生 Dana 与 Reza 只讨论练习材料的证据，不提供投资建议。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Dana
sentences.text: Our projection shows the café becoming profitable in the third month.

sentences.speaker: Reza
sentences.text: What number of daily orders does that assume?

sentences.speaker: Dana
sentences.text: Forty. We spoke to twelve prospective customers who said they liked the idea.

sentences.speaker: Reza
sentences.text: Interest isn't the same as a purchase, and twelve conversations don't establish forty orders a day.

sentences.speaker: Dana
sentences.text: Then the sales assumption needs to be much more visible.

sentences.speaker: Reza
sentences.text: Yes. Show it as an assumption, and keep those interview comments separate from actual sales.

sentences.speaker: Dana
sentences.text: I'll revise the slide that way rather than presenting profit as certain.
